reviews.text:
Dr. Esposito is truly a special person. She dedicated so much time to my dog's examination, listening carefully and trying to understand every aspect of the situation. Thanks to her, my dog ​​is finally feeling better!! She's incredibly professional, kind, compassionate, and empathetic, always available, despite her numerous patients.
What I appreciated most is that she asks lots of questions and LISTENS and REMEMBERS. I highly recommend her. ❤️
It's rare to meet a doctor like Dr. Esposito. She examined my cat very thoroughly and showed empathy beyond all expectations.
Excellent doctor. Attentive, thorough, and above all, she listens! She's very knowledgeable and very sweet. I definitely recommend her!
Good and well-known company in the area
